news.headline: Connixt Wins Two Progressive Railroading Reader’s Choice Awards for the Second Consecutive Year
iMarq Revolutionizes Field Operations with AI-Driven Intelligence and Real-Time Communication Tools
Connixt iMarq Earns 2025 Progressive Railroading Reader’s Choice Award
Smarter Maintenance Starts Here: iMarq Unveils Enhancements to AI-driven Insights, Inventory Management, and Communication
Connixt Brings AI to iMarq with their latest innovation, iBot
Connixt iMarq Integrates with Trimble TMT Enterprise Management Systems
Fleet Maintenance Made Modern: Connixt Changes the Game

paragraphs: Connixt sells iMarq, a mobile-first application built for field crews, technicians and mechanics to digitize and automate data collection, paperwork, processes and workflows. The company aims it at fleets, rail, transit, manufacturing, heavy engineering and facilities.

There are native apps for iOS and Android. They run on phones and tablets, both online and offline. Crews record asset details in the organization's own forms, on their own devices, in real time. An assistant called iBot puts institutional knowledge, troubleshooting guidance and compliance support in front of frontline teams, while reporting lets users reach their data on any device and track asset status.

Public agency case studies include a transportation department whose traffic signal division used the customizable mobile app to digitize work orders and improve transparency. Another covers Metrolink, which automated the train delay reporting its conductors had been doing on paper. The company reports winning two Progressive Railroading Reader's Choice Awards for a second consecutive year. It is run by two co-founders, Satish and Prabhu, described as industry veterans, and the site cites a 4.8 rating on Capterra.

quote.text: iMarq puts institutional knowledge, troubleshooting guidance and compliance support directly in the hands of frontline teams
